cohort: 859 women with low-risk deliveries in five public hospitals in Kosovo from April to May 2015
finding: Several health system characteristics were associated with increased caesarean section rates in a low-risk population of delivering women in public hospitals of Kosovo.
mod_finding: Several health system characteristics, including delivery by the physician who provided antenatal care, were associated with the increase of cesarean sections in a low-risk population of delivering women.
